articles.title: PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for October 2026 Announced
articles.summary: October's PlayStation Plus monthly games lineup has been officially revealed by Sony. This month's trio of titles include a slightly out of date racer, a monster-filled extraction shooter, and a multiplayer voxel shooter. Let's dive in.
body: Launched last year, F1 25 is the actually pretty good entry in Codemasters' long-running Formula 1 racing series that we awarded with an 8/10. "F1 25 is a far broader and better package than last year’s installment, and it’s comfortably the strongest the series has been since the fan favourite F1 2020," we wrote in IGN's F1 25 review.

Next up, Hunt: Showdown 1896, Crytek's first-person extraction shooter that sends you off to fight mythological monsters. Originally launched in early acces back in 2018, when we awarded the game a 7.5/10 in our Hunt: Showdown 1896 review, this PS5 version also features a battle royale offering. And don't worry if you haven't played the first 1895 games in the series, you'll soon pick it up.

Finally, Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 is available for PS4 and PS5. This third-person shooter with local and online co-op tells the story of what happened to the voxelEarth after the events of the first installment. Brothers from across the world reunite to face an unprecedented threat brought about by an all-new enemy that threatens to tear the Earth apart all over again.
points: October's PlayStation Plus monthly games lineup has been officially revealed by Sony.

articles.title: Scrubs Season 11: Episodes 1 & 2 Review
articles.summary: Scrubs Season 11 is off to a strong start, as this charming sitcom looks to improve on some of the flaws of Season 10. Read our review of the first two episodes.
body: The first two episodes of Scrubs Season 11 premiere on ABC on September 30 and on Hulu on October 1.

In an era where it's become customary to wait years between new seasons of many popular shows, it's certainly a treat to receive two seasons of Scrubs in the same calendar year. The previous revival season proved to be the ultimate sitcom comfort food. It effortlessly wiped away the stigma of Season 9 and won fans back over with its depiction of the eternal bromance between Drs. John Dorian (Zach Braff) and Christopher Turk (Donald Faison). Season 10 wasn't without its problems, but it was a fun little romp that recaptured the charming vibe of the original series. Season 11 is much the same, but with a slightly more ambitious storytelling approach for good measure.
points: Scrubs Season 11 is off to a strong start, as this charming sitcom looks to improve on some of the flaws of Season 10.

articles.title: Activision Should Hire Former Halo Devs For Next Mainline Game, Former Franchise Director Says
articles.summary: Now that development of future Halo games is being handled by Activision Blizzard's hands, some former developers of the series have spoken out to share their thoughts on the shocking but not entirely surprising mix-up.
body: Frank O’Connor has worked on Halo for over 20 years, first working as a writer and community manager before serving as the game's franchise creative director from 2003 to 2023. This is a guy who knows Halo like the back of his hand, and with all that series expertise, he took to LinkedIn on September 25 to share some thoughts on how to make the next Halo great.

"Pro-Tip: Do NOT tie it to hardware/services launch cycles, do not try to force it into a shape (or aging platform) that it can't fit and do NOT abandon sandbox," O’Connor said in response to Xbox's former social media manager, Genevieve Harrison, who was pontificating on Activision Blizzard's development tactics. "Pro-Pro-Tip: Hire Bungie, Halo Studios and other laid-off folk who are bursting w. talent and ideas that got nerfed or shut down over the years."
In laying out these tips, O’Connor gave three ways the next Halo game could bring the franchise back to its former glory.

The first is a "classic" Halo game that focuses on a sandbox, movement, and shooter experience. It'd be "tailored to a core audience [and] scaled to be successful with that core audience and attractive to a broader one so it can grow."

articles.title: GTA 6: Everything the New Screenshots Tell Us
articles.summary: The latest GTA 6 screenshots showcase a bunch of great new features, from tropical storms and hunting, to simulated citrus farms and beach-ready butts.
body: A huge amount of new GTA 6 information has arrived in the world courtesy of the latest issue of Game Informer. The magazine’s new cover story has revealed over 20 major new details, including how the world simulates tropical storms and some of the many animals that call Leonida home.

Arriving alongside all this new information is 12 brand new screenshots, provided by Rockstar for Game Informer’s exclusive coverage. That exclusivity means we can’t post them here on IGN, but we would like to talk about them, because many of them tell a deeper story about Grand Theft Auto 6. Across the dozen images, we can see many of the newly-revealed features in action, and the scenarios depicted point to gameplay functions that may well be present in the full game.

These new screenshots reintroduce us to the First Chapter, a Leonida motorcycle gang. Game Informer’s cover story explains that the Ambrosia region of the map is home to a “local biker gang calling the shots”, and it very much looks like we’ll be butting heads with them – we can see Jason making a hasty getaway from a few armed gang members.

articles.title: Geoffrey Rush Has an Idea for How Barbossa Can Return in Pirates of the Caribbean 6
articles.summary: Pirates of the Caribbean actor Geoffrey Rush has said he's keen to make a return to Disney's swashbuckling franchise, if only to "annoy Jack Sparrow" one last time. Rush is one of just three actors to appear in all five Pirates of the Caribbean movies, alongside Johnny Depp's Captain Jack Sparrow…
body: Of course, Rush's character Hector Barbossa died in the finale of 2016's Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales, the franchise's final film to date. But even this would not necessarily stop him from returning, Rush believes.

"There's been a big enough break," Rush told Entertainment Weekly, discussing his desire to return. "I said, you know, I sacrificed myself for my daughter, I don't want it to be too easy and too cheesy that I come back and go: 'give me another payday.' I respect the scale of the opera that's almost been created in that 20 year period.

"I liken it to... Shakespeare," Rush continued, "and Hamlet's father coming back as a ghost. I thought, that would take good writing but just to come back and annoy Jack Sparrow for one more go. I'd even say, get the fans to write in what they'd like to see happen."

articles.title: Xbox Disc-To-Digital Program Is Officially Live For Everyone
articles.summary: Following an initial rollout to Xbox Insiders, the Xbox disc-to-digital program is officially available for all Xbox One and Xbox Series X users. The program allows you to receive digital licenses for a whole bunch (but not all) of your physical Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S games, and Microsoft has…
body: In order to claim your digital license for a supported Xbox game, all you need to do is put it into an Xbox console while you're signed in. You'll get a notification to let you know you've received a license. One cool thing is this can be an Xbox Series X or an Xbox One console, even if you're exclusively claiming Xbox Series X games.

While the disc will also automatically start installing when you insert it, you can turn this feature off by going to the Profile & system section in the settings, then Devices & connections. You'll see an option for Disc and you can uncheck "Play disc automatically."

This way, you can more quickly claim licenses in bulk. With a disc inserted using this method, you'll have to manually select the game card on the home screen, select it with the Menu button, and then claim the digital license. Once that's done, you just eject the game and move on to the next one. When you've finished the process, re-check that "Play disc automatically" box for whenever you get your next physical game to play.
points: Following an initial rollout to Xbox Insiders, the Xbox disc-to-digital program is officially available for all Xbox One and Xbox Series X users.

articles.title: Ex-PlayStation Boss Has Some Advice For Xbox: “Pick A Lane”
articles.summary: Xbox has undergone major changes since a new leadership team took over. Under Xbox CEO Asha Sharma, Microsoft's gaming division has had waves of mass layoffs, parted ways with several studios, and consolidated its remaining developers under Activision, Blizzard, King, and Bethesda.
body: "Be that. This is your Dreamcast moment. When Sega decided, 'We're just going to be on PlayStation 2 and we're going to get out of the hardware business and just be a great software company. It can be done. It has been done before. That's my advice. Pick a lane."

The "Dreamcast moment" that Layden refers to is the rise and fall of Sega's last home console--the moment when Sega realised it could no longer compete in the gaming hardware market and had to shift entirely to software. Microsoft has been notoriously secretive with the sales of its Xbox hardware, as it's believed that it trails far behind Sony's PlayStation 5 (95.3 million units sold as of June 2026).

The future doesn't look too good for Xbox console sales either, as analysts predict that only 2.5 million Xbox Series X|S units will be sold in 2026, as Microsoft prepares for a "rapid wind-down toward zero" ahead of its next-gen console launch.

articles.title: Astarion's New 'Baldur's Gate 3' Prequel Story Was Doomed From the Start
articles.summary: In 2023, Larian Studios' venture into Dungeons & Dragons ’ Forgotten Realms with Baldur’s Gate 3 was a major success — and not just for the studio. Much like Critical Role ’s arrival inspired many nerds to take a new interest in tabletop role-playing games, Baldur’s Gate 3 had a similar effect.
body: Wizards of the Coast also announced four tie-in books from Penguin Random House, including an Astarion Acunin prequel novel (out now) from award-winning Nettle & Bone author T. Kingfisher (aka, Ursula Vernon). While all the B aldur’s Gate 3 companions are loved, the witty elf-vampire Astarion in particular has inspired a fervent, devoted fanbase, with many empathizing with the abuse he suffered at the hands of his cruel vampire master, Cazador.

Kingfisher has proven more than capable of handling dark, grim topics in books like The Twisted Ones, so it’s little wonder Wizards chose her to handle Astarion. With input from Astarion’s writer, Stephen Rooney, and voice actor, Neil Newbon, Kingfisher delivers an emotional whirlwind of a novel in Baldur's Gate 3: Astarion. But it was unfortunately doomed from the outset.

articles.title: This New Riftbound Card Is An Exciting Variant Of A Time-Traveling Legend
articles.summary: While it already feels like it's been around forever, October 31 will mark the one-year anniversary of Riftbound, the trading card game based on Riot Games's popular League of Legends franchise, releasing in Western markets.
body: There are many exciting cards being revealed as we get closer to Radiance's October 23 launch, and today, we have an exclusive look at the Overnumbered variants of one of the set's most notable names. We've seen the card's base form before, but this new art is a beauty to behold.
Without further ado, here's the Overnumbered variants for Ekko, Boy Who Shattered Time.

Ekko is known for his ability to bend time to his will, while also creating temporary clones of himself to confuse opponents. With this new card, he can effectively give that ability to other units in your deck, though they will be sent to the discard pile at the end of the turn.

Building a deck around this legend will capitalize on cards who can make an immediate impact on the board, like units with Accelerate who enter ready and can attack immediately. Considering that Accelerate costs are one exhausted rune and one recycled rune, Ekko's discount means you'll still pay less to summon the Accelerated unit.

articles.title: Silent Hill: Townfall’s Hardest Boss Is Getting Nerfed
articles.summary: Just about a week after Silent Hill: Townfall ' s release, developer Screen Burn has released a patch that hopes to address some early technical frustrations with the horror game. What's more exciting, however, is the reveal that a fix is in the works for one of the game's most frustrating parts.
body: If you've been playing Townfall, The Weight has likely been the bane of your existence. The creature periodically terrorizes protagonist Simon Ordell throughout the foggy town of St. Amelia, but is basically indestructible. That's because [ Warning: slight spoilers ahead.] The Weight is Townfall 's climactic final boss. The encounter, as it currently exists, is simply miserable. The Weight is a damage sponge, and the intermittent appearance of normal enemies during the fight makes the encounter exhausting.

The developer announced Patch 1.3.1 in a post on X. The patch itself improves stuttering issues on PC. Screen Burn also revealed that "We've heard you on struggles with The Weight — gameplay balancing on it's way asap." (Nobody tell them that there's a typo in that sentence, just be grateful a fix is coming.) There is no release date for the update yet, though hopefully it won't be long.

articles.summary: On Wednesday, Sony revealed the next batch of PlayStation Plus subscribers' free Essential games. Like most months, there's a little something for everyone on offer: F1 25, Hunt: Showdown 1896, and Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 will be free for subscribers.
body: EA has a game for every sport, and that includes the increasingly popular Formula One racing. F1 25 is the latest entry in the series, and received a paid expansion in June for the 2026 season, which includes new teams, drivers, and cars. Race offline in the Konnersport Career and My Team modes, or test your driving skills against other players online.

Hunt: Showdown 1896 is a first-person extraction shooter. You'll duke it out with ruthless monsters in the backwaters of the American Frontier across four different maps. Of course, it wouldn't be an extraction shooter if you weren't targeting other Hunters to get that sweet, sweet loot each match. You can try to hunt solo or in teams or two or three.

Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 is a wildly different shooter than Hunt: Showdown 1896. It's much brighter and colorful, and full of giant voxel enemies to destroy. The Earth is in danger, and it's up to you to defend it in single-player or four-player co-op modes. Select a squad from over 100 characters and outfit them with over 600 weapons and accessories to help save the planet.

articles.title: It's not even out yet, but Valve's Deadlock just became one of the most played games on Steam
articles.summary: Valve's new MOBA Deadlock - a sort of cross between Dota and Overwatch - might not be fully released yet, or even accessible by vast portions of the public,but that hasn't stopped its latest update propelling it to being one of the most played games on Steam.
body: Yesterday, Valve released a huge City Never Sleeps update for Deadlock. This drastically overhauled the map, added six new heroes, introduced a deluge of fresh voice lines, and included multiple HUD and quality-of-life updates. It was a major moment for the game, which is still yet to get a release date.

Even so, those who do have access to Deadlock flew to it in droves. The game quickly climbed the rankings in Steam's most played category, and yesterday it reached 228,086 concurrent players, according to SteamDB - the largest figure in its history.

Among the many additions the Deadlock community has attached itself to in the City Never Sleeps update are the new voice lines. The update more than doubled the character interaction lines. The Deadlock Reddit page is full of highlights picked out by players, who are delighted to see more personality expressed by the game's growing cast of oddball characters.

articles.title: The Pokémon Center Opens Pre-Orders For Delta Reign, The Next Big TCG Set
articles.summary: The Pokémon Center has officially opened up pre-orders for Delta Reign, its Rayquaza-themed set that will be released on Nov. 4. Here's what's up for sale — and what you can expect.
body: The set includes over 135 cards, 14 Illustration Rare cards, 17 Ultra-Rare cards, and six Special Illustration Rare cards. The big chase cards are expected to be Mega Rayquaza ex (and its golden variant), Raikou ex, Groudon, Growlithe, Magmortar, Electivire, and Kecleon. Collectors are also looking forward to the hobby's first-ever embroidered card.

The big ticket item is, of course, the green and blue Elite Trainer Box, which comes with 11 booster packs, sleeves, dice, coins, and a Kyogre illustration rare card. The MSRP is $59, but the competition for this one will be fierce. Pokémon Center ETBs are highly sought-after, and tend to have high prices on the resale market thanks to the special Pokémon Center promo stamp on the box and promo cards. The limit for ETBs has historically been two per purchase.

Judging by pre-orders for the last couple of sets, the ETB will sell out first. The entire pre-order window should last several hours overall. The Pokémon Center's stock tends to be huge for the initial wave of pre-orders.

articles.title: Tinker, Bard, Illusionist - Blizzard seemingly surveying World of Warcraft: Forever players about never-before-seen classes to add to the game
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever players claim to have been sent a survey asking whether they'd be interested in a variety of new classes for the upcoming MMO - and some of them are very interesting.
body: Over the past few days, a select few users of Blizzard's Battle.net launcher spotted an opt-in survey. While Blizzard requested participants not share details of this survey, screenshots and information have nevertheless leaked online. As a result, popular World of Warcraft YouTubers such as Belluar have covered its contents.

The classes that appear to have been polled in this survey can be split between wholly new ideas, or spins on established classes from modern World of Warcraft. Some examples of those refreshed classes include Death Knights, Demon Hunters, and Monks. But these would likely have significantly different playstyles given the significant differences between modern WoW and WoW: Forever.

For example, per alleged survey information on the Demon Hunter, the class would be far slower and less mobile than its World of Warcraft: Legion counterpart. Likewise, these demon hunters would not be members of Illidan's faction of demon hunters we've grown to love; rather a smaller pre-existing faction out somewhere in Azeroth, separate from his shirtless edginess.
points: World of Warcraft: Forever players claim to have been sent a survey asking whether they'd be interested in a variety of new classes for the upcoming MMO - and some of them are very interesting.

articles.title: "My god this new lighting is lifeless" - The Witcher 3 Remastered Edition divides players for a few key reasons
articles.summary: Yesterday's free Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered upgrade might have propelled the old role-playing game to new heights, in terms of player popularity, but not everyone is happy with what's changed.
body: The lighting is such an issue for some people they're asking developer CD Projekt Red for a way to roll back their version of The Witcher 3 - which you can't easily do on console as far as I'm aware (though there are various options on PC). "You people should figure out a way for Xbox users to play the older version because my god this new lighting is lifeless," wrote one irate person on X. "What's the point of removing all whimsy of a fantasy game? Realism is the death of escapism."

"I prefer the old look," said another player on Reddit, who provided detailed comparison images. "It has better contrast, with stronger highlights and a more pronounced overall image." Another video was linked that painstakingly compares the Witcher 3 Remastered edition with the next-gen edition and the original edition of the game.

videos.title: Asylum - Release Date Trailer | PS5 Games
videos.summary: The doors of Hanwell Mental Institute are opening once again…
body: ASYLUM, the psychological horror adventure from the creators of Scratches and Serena, is coming to consoles on October 30, 2026.

Step into the mind of a former patient plagued by bizarre and disturbing visions. Explore the decaying halls of Hanwell Mental Institute, investigate its dark history, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the horrors hidden within its walls.
Every corridor holds a secret. Every vision brings you closer to the truth.

videos.title: Overwatch – Doctrine New Hero Gameplay Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
videos.summary: Play Overwatch now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch:
body: Out of the shadows comes the newest Support Hero, Doctrine, who can manipulate life itself to heal allies and damage enemies with the help of his Eternal Scepter. Dodge incoming fire with his Shrouded Momentum ability, and send out Invigorating Drones to an ally for increased attack speed and healing.

Doctrine’s Infuse takes things to the next level by adding extra power to whichever ability he uses next, like gaining free-flight when infusing his Shrouded Momentum or piercing damage when infusing his next Eternal Scepter attack. Finally, unleash his Ultimate, Deliverance, to grant allies overhealth while reducing the maximum health of your enemies.
